_comment: The two images in the tester-invitation email.
Both cards show the whole capture. `crop`, `zoom` and `focusx` are available per card and both
of these use none of them: cropping the top off the WhatsApp shot also crops off the fact that
it is WhatsApp, and a home screen zoomed until the floating mark is large stops reading as a
home screen. Recognition is the argument, so the frame grew instead.
The captions are not the store captions. The store speaks to strangers and has to explain that
punctuation is automatic. These readers already dictate with VibeVoice every day -- to them that
is a premise, not news. So the cards name the thing they have actually been putting up with.
